frames.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual.
Create ONE finished, individual landscape presentation frame, exact aspect ratio 16:9, requested 1536x864 pixels. This is one frame in a coordinated four-frame metric series. Do NOT create a collage or four-panel image.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND ROBOT CHARACTER FAMILY reference, not an edit target and not a layout to reproduce.
Style: match its elegant black-and-white Lorelei-inspired editorial ink robots very closely: rounded rectangular white heads and body shells, black inset face screens, expressive white eyes, round ear-like joints, simple mechanical hands, confident slightly irregular black outlines, subtle organic variation in line weight. White background, pure black ink. NO colors, gray shading, shadows, gradients, textures, hatching or photorealism.
Composition CONSISTENT ACROSS SERIES: generous 7% margins; left 56% is a clean typographic metric block, right 37% one large waist-up robot illustration with a simple relevant prop. Top of content around 19% canvas height. Heading in medium-bold clean sans-serif; huge bold percentage underneath, largest element on the page; then clear count caption and one short explanatory line. A thin short black rule above a discreet readable footer near bottom. Left-align all copy to same margin. Clear visual separation, no boxes around the slide, no dashboard cards, no ornament, no logo, no watermark, no page number.
Cyrillic typography must be impeccable and comfortably readable. Use decimal COMMA exactly as specified. The percentage is a measured/documented pilot metric, so avoid trophies, celebratory badges, 100%-style symbols, checkmark wall or a false impression of perfection.
These are standalone metric slides, NOT scientific plots. Do not add any graph, data visualization, gauges, circles, rating stars, unlabeled percentages, or numerically meaningful rows of objects.
Footer EXACT on every frame: "По сводке API • 40 видео • Qwen3.5-9B • NVIDIA L4"
Use ONLY the exact provided heading, percentage, caption, explanation, footer. No additional prose or text.

Exact heading: "Верный вердикт"
Exact huge metric: "82,5%"
Exact count caption: "33 из 40 видео"
Exact explanatory line: "Есть нарушение / нет нарушения"
Robot illustration: One attentive robot with a broad rounded rectangular head holding a small review clipboard with two generic horizontal ink lines and a single modest check mark. It looks thoughtfully toward the metric. Friendly, calm, competent; no exaggerated triumph.
